messages.subject: RE: Question
parts:
To whom it may concern,

Please see the R script below.  Using the script below,  I ran structural equation modeling for ordinal variables.  It used to work very well. 
All of sudden, it did not work any more. I received the messages below in yellow.

Would please tell me what went wrong?  Thank you for your support.

Dae-Young

> model<- '
+ #latent variables
+ PLE =~ Q11_1R + Q11_4R + Q11_5R + Q11_6R
+ PCC =~ Q12_1 + Q12_2 + Q12_4
+ PBWC =~ Q15_2R + Q15_3R + Q16_1R + Q21_2R
+ PCR =~ Q17_2R + Q17_3R + Q17_5R + Q19_2R
+ #regressions
+ Q11_3R ~ YearsExp
+ PLE ~ YearsExp + Q11_3R
+ PCC ~ YearsExp + Q11_3R
+ PBWC ~ YearsExp + Q11_3R + PLE + PCC
+ PCR ~ YearsExp + Q11_3R + PLE + PCC + PBWC'
>
> fit<-sem(model,data=mydata, mimic = "Mplus", estimator = "WLSMV", ordered=c("Q11_1R","Q11_4R","Q11_5R","Q11_6R","Q11_3R","Q12_1","Q12_2","Q12_4","Q15_2R","Q15_3R","Q16_1R","Q21_2R","Q17_2R","Q17_3R","Q17_5R","Q19_2R"))

Error in lavaan::lavaan(model = model, data = mydata, ordered = c("Q11_1R",  :
  lavaan ERROR: some latent variable names collapse with observed
                variable names: PLE PCC PCR
>
>
> summary(fit,fit.measures=TRUE,standardized=TRUE,rsquare=TRUE)

Error in summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE) :
  object 'fit' not found
>

  lavaan ERROR: some latent variable names collapse with observed

The message indicates that you define latent variables using names of observed variables in your data.  You can verify that by checking names(mydata), and consider using alternative names for the latents.
